brief: Crews must apply the loading reductions specified in MG-021 from the third day of the heat event due to sustained conditions with warm overnight minima, and run forced cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than letting the thermostat drop stages out as outlined in MG-025. If any vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity as directed in SOP-011. Record every de-rating applied and its reason in accordance with MG-021.
